cases.evidence: The diff replaces an additive ALTER TABLE with DROP TABLE followed by CREATE TABLE, changing the persisted schema operation and discarding existing readings.
The exported label function still returns String(value).trim(); the diff only extracts that unchanged expression into a local normalize helper.
The diff changes a Cargo.lock version from 1.0.0 to 2.0.0, altering a locked dependency or build input.
The product contract changes restore activation from requiring prior integrity validation to permitting activation before validation.
The generated client artifact changes its endpoint path from /v1/readings to /v2/readings.
The diff removes verify_backup_digest from the restore path, changing restore integrity validation behavior.
The same value !== null predicate is moved from a named local function into an inline filter callback.
The service bind address changes from loopback-only 127.0.0.1 to all interfaces 0.0.0.0.
The unchanged constant separator value "/" is moved from module scope into format, while the returned template expression remains the same.
The DELETE query changes from removing only acknowledged readings to removing every reading, changing deletion semantics and risking data loss.
The JSON field name changes from delivery_state to state, changing the supplied data schema.
The acknowledgement is reordered before store.append, so an acknowledgement can be sent before durable storage succeeds.
The visible console status changes from a pending retry state to a completed-delivery state.
The diff removes requireAdmin(actor) before destroying a user, changing authorization enforcement.
The implementation switches from transform(input) to helper(input), but the diff supplies no definitions establishing equivalent behavior.
